# Nehemiah 7 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Nehemiah 7 (73 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 2

---

## V.2 — "faithful man" vs. "man of integrity"
- **EMET:** "faithful man" (*ish emet*) / **LOGOS:** "faithful man" / **PNEUMA:** "man of exceptional integrity"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "man of integrity" — Hebrew *ish emet* means "man of truth/faithfulness." "Integrity" captures the breadth of *emet*. PNEUMA's "exceptional" is an unnecessary intensifier.

---

## V.4 — "no houses had been rebuilt" vs. "most houses had not been rebuilt"
- **EMET:** "no houses were-built" / **LOGOS:** "no houses had been rebuilt" / **PNEUMA:** "most of the houses had not yet been rebuilt"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "no houses had been rebuilt" — The Hebrew *eyn banuy* states absolutely "none were built." PNEUMA softens beyond what the text warrants.

---

*— SOPHIA*
